purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official South Imenti Form 34B final TOTAL row and preserve an internal source denominator conflict without promotion.

sample.review_context_note: Rendered at 400 DPI directly from the freshly downloaded, sha256-verified official IEBC Form 34B PDF (4 pages; polling-station rows span pages 1-3, TOTAL row is the final green-shaded row on page 3 after KAIGENE TEA BUYING CENTRE - 01). This constituency's form columns are Registered Voters, Odinga Raila, Ruto William Samoei, Waihiga David Mwaure, Wajackoyah George Luchiri, Total Valid Votes, Rejected Ballots (no separate Votes Cast column). The TOTAL row digits are unambiguous at 400 DPI.

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session (via the governed form_id = constituency_code + 277628 locator, after resetting the portal session from its default by-election context to the 2022 general election via index.php?r=common/set-election&id=5, and cross-checked against the independent portal manifest discovery in scripts/p23/discover-iebc-form34b-manifest.py), its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image. No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.

row_reconciliation.governed_p23_registered_voters_source: KDA-VOTERS-CON-059-2022 (data/indicators/registry/observations.json), sourced from the pre-election official IEBC First Schedule registered-voters gazette, published 2022-06-21

note: Total Valid Votes, Rejected Ballots and the candidate cells are individually clear and internally reconcile on the printed TOTAL row (candidate sum 79331 = printed Total Valid Votes). However, the row's own printed Registered Voters figure (115657) does not exactly match the separately governed P23 registered-voter denominator for this constituency (115642). Candidate cells reconcile exactly to Total Valid Votes (9,706+69,050+140+435=79,331). No single polling station across all 4 pages of this constituency's Form 34B has a registered-voter count of exactly 15 (the delta), and no prison or other special-facility station name is visible on any page; the 15-voter gap between the printed TOTAL row denominator and the governed First Schedule denominator is not explained by any single identifiable source-page entry. Per the extraction contract's exact-reconciliation requirement for registered_voters (mismatch_treatment: unresolved), this row is preserved unresolved and no turnout observation may be promoted from this evidence until the denominator conflict is independently reconciled.
